control.Description:
CPU-only vBuf-ML compatibility runtime (Alpha)
A small OpenAI-compatible vBuf-ML runtime package for Debian amd64. It
includes the existing vbuf_compat_server target and its private Rust
vBuf-ML consumer library. No model weights or payloads are included.
.
This is an Alpha distribution, not a general model-support or coding-agent
qualification. CUDA is disabled. Qwen3-8B remains explicitly experimental,
and Native AV remains stopped and fail-closed.
